proposedEntry.name: acr-reporting
proposedEntry.description: Converts a finished accessibility evaluation into an Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) draft in OpenACR format for handoff to GSA's ACR Editor. Every value must trace to the source evaluation report or evidence spine: untested Level A/AA criteria receive no adherence term and block draft completion; `not-evaluated` applies only to Level AAA; severity never determines the adherence term (only tested outcomes do); required inputs (evaluation report, evidence findings, author contact, report date, product name/version) are all mandatory or the skill blocks. Validates output with the pinned `@openacr/openacr` CLI. Output is always a DRAFT requiring human sign-off before publication — never a final or signed ACR.
triggers: turn this accessibility audit into an ACR
convert findings to a VPAT/ACR draft
inputs: a contract-conformant evaluation report with per-criterion outcomes
evidence findings with identifiers and sample context, author contact, report date, product name/version
outputs: a DRAFT OpenACR YAML/document with outcome-to-adherence terms mapped per criterion
a validation pass against the pinned @openacr/openacr CLI
